author: Noel Eves
content: I found Dancing Cubs by google search for a kids party where I wanted a good selection of toys for the kids to play outside in the garden. They have a huge range and their customer service was quick, polite and helpful. They came the day before so our kids had an extra day of fun with everything before the party itself and the toys were clean and in good condition. The staff were really friendly and put everything together properly and same when they came to collect. The kids had a great time with the toys and the slide / ballpit combo was a huge hit. I would definitely recommend them.
